description: Header file defining structures, types, and function prototypes for nl80211 socket management in a wireless driver or application, including counters, driver IDs, and API functions.

classes.name: wld_nl80211_state_t
classes.description: Opaque structure representing nl80211 socket manager state.

classes.name: wld_nl80211_listener_t
classes.description: Opaque structure representing nl80211 event listener.

classes.name: wld_nl80211_channelSurveyInfo_t
classes.description: Abstract type for nl80211 channel survey information.

classes.name: wld_nl80211_channelSurveyParam_t
classes.description: Abstract type for nl80211 channel survey parameters.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_newState
methods.description: Creates a new nl80211 socket context.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getSharedState
methods.description: Returns the shared nl80211 socket manager, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and frees a specific nl80211 socket manager context.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_cleanupAll
methods.description: Cleans up and frees all nl80211 socket managers.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getStateCounters
methods.description: Retrieves counters for a specific nl80211 socket manager.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getAllCounters
methods.description: Retrieves global counters across all nl80211 socket managers.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getDriverIds
methods.description: Provides nl80211 driver IDs learned at runtime from the kernel.
